edges.target_label: X-AuT: Progressive Audio-Encoder Compression for Speech LLMs with Cross-Scale Distillation (2026)
edges.note: Audio Mamba addressed audio-encoder cost by replacing attention with a state-space model and retraining from scratch; X-AuT keeps the trained transformer encoder and removes depth from it, because a pretrained encoder attached to a frozen language model is an asset an architecture swap discards.

edges.target_label: X-AuT: Progressive Audio-Encoder Compression for Speech LLMs with Cross-Scale Distillation (2026)
edges.note: HeAR established that a general health-acoustic encoder transfers across tasks and left deployment cost untouched; X-AuT supplies the compression recipe such an encoder would need on a device, with the language backbone frozen throughout.

edges.target_label: X-AuT: Progressive Audio-Encoder Compression for Speech LLMs with Cross-Scale Distillation (2026)
edges.note: Stacked attention layers are the unit of encoder capacity this work prunes; the result that 18 to 16 layers improved macro-average error from 5.61 to 5.27 percent says the original depth sat on the wrong side of the capacity-noise trade-off for this decoder.
